structured.answer: A deposit locks my money at the bank for a fixed time (like 12 months) at a set interest (1.8% in the example). If I break it early the bank can fine me and the site doesn't say how much. In the example, after 10 years in today's money I'd have 68,270 ₪ against 70,000 ₪ put in, so it doesn't really grow.
